methods.name: list
methods.description: Every configured agent with its handle, instructions, model route, preset and usage. Read-only.

methods.name: get
methods.description: One agent by `@handle`, or null when no agent has that handle. Read-only.

methods.name: presets
methods.description: The Agent presets this Host can start a thread with, for an agent whose preset decides its tools. Not an agent tool.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Create or update one agent. May run only when the user asked for that change.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Remove one agent. Destructive: requires `confirm: true`, which is never implied by a bare request.

methods.name: recordUse
methods.description: Record a dispatch: bump last-used time and count, and keep the thread it opened so the panel can list it after a Host restart. Not an agent tool.

methods.name: threads
methods.description: The threads one agent started, newest first, with their titles and start times. Read-only.

methods.name: threadAgent
methods.description: The agent that started one thread, by Session id, or null for a thread no agent started. Read-only; a cross-plugin lookup, not an agent tool.
